---
title: "Exercises"
---

Exercises should be usable in a classroom, workshop or self-directed setting. They may be embedded within modules or provided as separate downloadable resources.

## Suggested structure

1. State the learning objective.
2. Describe the setting and task.
3. Give learners only the information needed to begin.
4. Provide prompts that encourage reasoning rather than recall alone.
5. Put suggested answers or facilitator notes in collapsible sections.
6. State any assumptions and reasonable alternative answers.

The [effect-size module](../modules/effect-sizes.qmd#check-your-understanding) contains the first short exercises.
